jobs.title: Aseptic Engineering Program Manager
jobs.location: Victorville, California, United States; Hesperia, California, United States; Apple Valley, California, United States
jobs.description:
Job Overview:
*Relocation Assistance Eligible*

The Aseptic Whole Line Performance Leader is accountable for the safe, reliable, and efficient performance of the complete Sidel and Krones aseptic production line—from blow molding through filling, capping, conveying, labeling, packaging, and palletizing. This role owns execution and results across the line, including safety, quality, customer fill rate, case attainment, OEE2, unplanned and planned downtime, waste, and cost per case.

The Aseptic Whole Line Performance Leader will establish and execute the operating strategy for the Sidel and Krones aseptic line, aligning Operations, Maintenance, Quality, Engineering, Planning, and OEM support to deliver sustained top-quartile whole-line performance.

The role leads daily line execution, loss elimination, reliability improvement, operating discipline, and capability development across the entire aseptic process. Responsibilities include setting performance priorities, coordinating shift and functional resources, leading tiered performance reviews, removing systemic constraints, ensuring operational readiness for product, package, and equipment changes, and sustaining improvements through standard work, preventive maintenance, centerlining, root cause problem solving, and operator and technician skill development.

The Aseptic Whole Line Performance Leader is a key member of the Plant Leadership Team and serves as the single point of accountability for Sidel and Krones aseptic line performance. The role connects Operations, Maintenance, Quality, Engineering, Planning, and OEM partners; establishes clear priorities and owners; escalates barriers; and ensures corrective actions are completed and sustained. This position reports to the Plant Manager.

Location: Victorville, CA

What you will do:
- Own Whole-Line Performance for the Sidel and Krones Aseptic Line
- Develop and lead a cross-functional rapid response team capable of diagnosing, containing, and permanently eliminating losses across the complete aseptic line.
- Serve as the line owner between CAPEX teams, OEMs, and the plant for new installations, ensuring design integration, operational readiness, vertical ramp-up, and sustained performance across the connected line.
- Work with E&T Pillar owner to develop training for technical independence
- Work with AM/PM Pillar owner to develop Platinum Level PMs, CIL, cleaning and OH schedules
- Work with AM/PM Pillar to ensure annual audits are completed in a timely manner
- Work with OEMs on pricing for parts – align with audits and OH for group/bulk pricing
- Vertical ramp up of new equipment installs aligning with your SME category
- Lead capital projects, executing with excellence and vertical ramp ups.
- Collaborate with corporate Supply Planning team on network capacity plans in delivering critical equipment maintenance activities.
- Collaborate with site leadership to ensure Operations Model labor standards are being met for maintenance teams.
- Lead and deliver maintenance and reliability related productivity projects.
- Responsible for functional area network dashboards, and corrective actions to drive KPI improvement. Drives sustainable improvements to positively impact the achievement of Key Performance Indicators (KPI’s), Manage SRM Dashboards, and Scorecards relative to cost, productivity and on-time delivery by optimizing labor and production capabilities.
- Work with Human Resources and Talent Acquisition to develop and execute improvement strategies for engagement, recruiting and retention across the network.
- Implement best practices and continuous improvement initiatives to optimize cases per maintenance labor hour.
- Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements and bargaining agreements related to maintenance department planning as it relates to KDP programs.
- Develops tools to acquire, trend and analyze efficient production output.
- Follows all policies, ergonomic standards and safety requirements directed by KDP and the department.
- Liaison with OEM’s on training curriculum to ensure Operational Readiness that supports vertical start-ups and sustainable OOE2
- Performs other duties as requested by management.

Total Rewards:
- Salary Range: $96,800 - $150,000
- Actual placement within the compensation range may vary depending on experience, skills, and other factors
- Benefits, subject to election and eligibility: Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Paid Time Off (including paid parental leave, vacation, and sick time), 401k with company match, Tuition Reimbursement, and Mileage Reimbursement
- Annual bonus based on performance and eligibility
- Benefits eligible Day 1!
- Relocation Assistance Eligible*

Requirements:
- Expertise in Aseptic Blow Molding, Filling and Capping
- Experience with aseptic filling is required
- Bachelor's degree in a Science, Technical/Engineering preferred. Master’s degree in business or engineering management a plus
- Project management certification a plus
- Minimum of 10 years of experience in a combination of manufacturing and engineering
- Demonstrated management experience and performance improvement in equipment maintenance and reliability.
- Highly competent knowledge of SAP/CMMS transactional processes
- Excellent leadership skills with a proven track record of leading teams and managing large-scale projects.
- Ability to develop and implement effective maintenance strategies.
- Knowledge of regulatory requirements related to equipment and facilities maintenance.
- Experience in the food and beverage industry is preferred.

Company Overview:

Our North American refreshment beverage business holds leadership positions across carbonated soft drinks, water, juice and mixers with a portfolio of iconic brands such as Dr Pepper®, Canada Dry®, Mott’s®, A&W®, Peñafiel®, GHOST®, 7UP®, Snapple®, Clamato® and Core Hydration®. jobs.description:
Job Overview:
**Relocation Assistance Available

Looking for a fresh start? A company help grow your skillset and advance your career? Apply Today! We are happy to speak with you about your experience and how you may be a fit within our teams. Lots of exciting things are happening at KDP and we'd love for you to be a part of it! Want to see more? Click the link to visit our website to view some awesome, short clips and information to show you what we're all about  KDP Company Overview . You may also view all of our current openings on our Careers Page.

Director of Operations (Plant Manager):
The Plant Manager is responsible for Leading and driving all operation activities to ensure consistent levels of production excellence are achieved and sustained whilst maintaining a fully engaged and talented workforce. Provide vision and direction for the entire facility in order to ensure current and future success. Ensure the facility attains/exceeds key performance measures and maximizes profitability by building short and long-term strategies and initiatives to meet customer, market and competitive demands; developing and communicating clear expectations and focus; and providing required resources and guidance as necessary.

Position Responsibilities
- Drives continuous improvements in key areas, such as: Safety, Quality, Productivity, Cost & Customer Service, while developing direct reports.  Improves upon the capabilities of all plant personnel.
- Required to build a Safety First culture and develops highly motivated workforce; serves as a positive role model of emotional intelligence and servant leadership.  Drives positive employee relations and delivers sustainable results.
- Continuously improves site processes and technologies; stays current in new technological developments.  Develops and executes upon a site capital plan, addressing both short-term a long-term opportunities.
- Champions continuous improvement efforts; implements and sustains manufacturing best practices / procedures, and meets/exceeds relevant certifications / qualifications / requirements (E.g. OSHA, AlB, GMP, HACCP, FSSC, and FDA).
- Identifies and eliminates potential sources of food safety risk.  Responsible for delivering site environmental, health, & safety performance; works to exceed expectations for all internal & external audits.
- Acts as liaison between plant personnel and corporate functions; builds solid relationships between these teams.  Effectively communicates urgent issues both internal and external to the site, as needed.  Identifies issues quickly, develops action plans and coordinates team member activities, so that these issues are communicated upward, and dealt with quickly & effectively.
- Develops a highly effective site leadership team, by applying high standards for selection and continued performance; establishes clear and stretching goals, communicates and delegates key responsibilities, and actively utilizes all performance, development and career tools, to their full potential.
- Requires Lean, A3 and relevant TPM skill sets, with demonstrated problem solving capability.  Must be competent in identifying root causes of issues and adept at developing and implementing corrective actions, to prevent problems from repeating.
- Required to implement Lean & TPM across all site areas, to elevate site performance; must also develop, deploy, & sustain Leader Standard Work, to ensure continued success of these efforts.

Total Rewards:
- Salary Range: $155,500 - $205,000
- Actual placement within the compensation range may vary depending on experience, skills, and other factors
- Benefits, subject to election and eligibility: Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Paid Time Off (including paid parental leave, vacation, and sick time), 401k with company match, Tuition Reimbursement, and Mileage Reimbursement
- Short Term and Long Term incentives
- Annual bonus based on performance and eligibility
- Benefits eligible Day 1!

Requirements:
- Minimum of 5 years Manufacturing Experience
- Minimum of 2 years' Experience in Operations Leadership
- Lean Six Sigma, PMP, TPM or other relevant certifications Preferred
- Bachelor's Degree Preferred

jobs.title: Director of Operations
jobs.description:
Job Overview:
Director of Sales Operations - Los Angeles, CA

The Director of Sales Operations drives strategic analysis, execution, and organizational development to achieve financial and non-financial goals in addition to creating a lean mindset throughout the assigned DSD facility to improve safety, productivity and performance through standardization and process discipline.
This role is accountable for the development of field personnel and achieving performance objectives in Safety, Quality, Delivery, Productivity, and Growth.

Through active leadership the Director of Sales Operations will:
- Drive accident and injury reduction and vehicle accident reduction targets in assigned facility.
- Provide case management and follow up on all SAFE system cases and ensure that proper accident investigations, classifications, follow-ups and Root Cause Counter Measures are determined.
- Drive Safety First culture by ensuring monthly Regulatory and Safety in Motion training is completed by all employees and Safety Playbooks are implemented with 100% compliance.
- Ensure regulatory compliance by conducting OSHA style audits and ensuring closure of any regulatory gaps to achieve 100% regulatory compliance.
- Drive increase in On Time and Accurate (OTA) score by addressing routing and delivery issues as well as ensuring pick accuracy exceeds 99.8% through full execution of Voice Pick standards and compliance to daily checklist and reduction of haulbacks.
- Drive reduction in waste by ensuring assigned facility meets or exceeds break/shrink/obsolescence goals on a cost per case basis.
- Ensure labor costs in the warehouse and delivery operations of assigned facility meet or beat plan on a cost per case basis by driving home Warehouse University principles, including the deployment of the Warehouse Self Assessment tool.
- Communicate regularly with internal and external partners and customers through weekly operations calls and as needed meetings to ensure high level of customer service is maintained.
- Drive facility-level engagement plans and ensure employee engagement in large teams and/or across many sites.
- P&L Responsibility: Responsible for the management of the facility
- Ensure high performance results of your team:
- Foster a culture of trust and wellbeing that prioritizes the team and values employee contributions.
- Drive a shared vision with clear goals and accountability, supported by regular conversations to maximize talent.
- Embrace diverse perspectives to foster innovation, learning from both successes and failures.
- Establish a safe environment where team members are motivated, heard, and aligned with clear expectations.

- Travel required as needed

The ideal candidate will possess:
- A proven track record of improving safety results, successful continuous improvement initiatives and superior cost and management results.
- Strong leadership and communication skills; excellent verbal and written skills along with experience presenting to regional leadership teams, local leadership teams, and frontline employees.
- A background in the management of Warehouse, Inventory and Delivery.
- Knowledge of Department of Transportation (DOT), Federal, State and Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) compliance.
- Experience working with MHE, (material handling equipment) understand warehouse capacity requirements, building, loading, and delivery principals, FIFO and logistics principals.

Total Rewards:
- $160,000 - $180,000 / year
- Actual placement within the compensation range may vary depending on experience, skills, and other factors
- Benefits, subject to election and eligibility: Medical, Dental and Vision, Paid Time Off, 401(k) program with employer match, Child & Elder Care, Adoption Benefits, Paid Parental Leave, Fertility Benefits, Employee Resource Groups, Breastmilk Shipping Services, Dependent Scholarship Program, Education Assistance, Employee Assistance Program, Personalized Wellness Platform and more!
- Annual bonus based on performance and eligibility

Requirements:
- High school diploma or general equivalency diploma (GED) with 7 years’ experience in a distribution center / DSD Warehouse environment OR a Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or related field with 5 years’ experience in a distribution center / DSD Warehouse environment
- Strong understanding of Department of Transportation (DOT), Federal, State and Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) compliance
- Experience presenting to executive leadership teams, local leadership teams, and front line employees
- Prior people leadership experience in a distribution center or operations environment
- Ability to manage an operation strategically and tactically to deliver results and long term initiatives
- Experience with extracting data from business systems and analyzing to make business decisions
- Advanced skills using Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams)

jobs.title: Summer 2027 Intern – Continuous Improvement (Aspers, PA)
jobs.description:
Job Overview:
Summer 2027 Intern – Continuous Improvement

As a 2027 Summer Intern at Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP), you will have the opportunity to work in a challenging, highly technical and dynamic Manufacturing and warehouse environment that produces some of KDP’s most recognized beverages. In this role you will have the opportunity to help provide insight on the future of how we move finished goods within our local footprint, ultimately improving our time to market.

This role is aligned to the Beverage Operating Unit.

Shift/Schedule:
- The KDP 2027 Summer Internship Program will run from June 7 – August 13, 2027
- Full-time; 40 hours per week
- Monday-Friday
- 8:00am until 5:00pm
- In-person in the Aspers, PA facility

As a Continuous Improvement intern you will:
- Analyze the current flow of materials and products across a multi-building distribution and warehouse network to identify inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.
- Gain exposure to project management activities, including project planning, vendor coordination, sourcing initiatives, and oversight of operational improvement projects.
- Leverage data analytics to evaluate inventory placement and develop strategic recommendations for optimizing product storage within the existing facility footprint.
- Partner with operations teams to understand daily workflows, identify process bottlenecks, and recommend solutions that improve efficiency, productivity, and overall operational flow.
- Participate in continuous improvement initiatives by collecting and analyzing operational data to support informed decision-making and process optimization efforts.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with supply chain, warehouse, and logistics teams to enhance material movement, storage utilization, and operational effectiveness.

Elements of the KDP 2027 Internship Program include:
- Engaging and partnering on innovative projects to gain experience in a fast paced, cross functional team environment
- Receive mentor support for your professional development
- Participate in meet & greets and lunch & learns with KDP executives and other organization leaders
- Receive professional development training such as networking, professional skills development and presenting
- Complete a project from start to finish and present it and your takeaways to your team, department, and senior leaders to highlight your project work and impact on the business

Total Rewards:
- $31.00/ hour
- Paid bi-weekly
- $2,500 Sign-on Bonus, paid within first 30 days of employment

Requirements:
- Undergraduate currently enrolled in a full time academic program from an accredited college or university, majoring in Business Management, Process Engineering, or another related field
- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize requests, and meet deadlines
- Strong communication skills including excellent listening, written, and verbal abilities
- Ability to work cross-functionally, be independently driven, and adapt to changes
- Strong skills in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; Ability to use advanced tools to formalize data and make suggestions on process improvement is a plus

Please note: You must be work authorized in the United States on a full time basis without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future. The Company cannot offer employment to F-1 (student) visa holders who require employer sponsorship in the future or cannot work now on a full time basis.

jobs.description:
Job Overview:
Summer 2027 Intern – Continuous Improvement

As a 2027 Summer Intern at Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP) in Northlake, IL, you will have the opportunity to work in a challenging, highly technical and dynamic Manufacturing and warehouse environment that produces some of KDP’s most recognized beverages. In this role you will have the opportunity to help provide insight on the future of how we move finished goods within our local footprint, ultimately improving our time to market.

This role is aligned to the Beverage Operating Unit.

Shift/Schedule:
- The KDP 2027 Summer Internship Program will run from June 7 – August 13, 2027
- Full-time; 40 hours per week
- Monday-Friday
- 8:00am until 5:00pm
- In-person in the Northlake, IL facility

As a Continuous Improvement intern you will:
- Analyze the current flow of materials and products across a multi-building distribution and warehouse network to identify inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.
- Gain exposure to project management activities, including project planning, vendor coordination, sourcing initiatives, and oversight of operational improvement projects.
- Leverage data analytics to evaluate inventory placement and develop strategic recommendations for optimizing product storage within the existing facility footprint.

- $31.00/ hour
- Paid bi-weekly

Job Overview:
Operations Manager - Avenel, NJ, Pennsylvania, Ohio, West Virginia, New York
Travel Required 75%-100%
Must be open to Relocation

Are you ready to join a growing, dynamic company?  Keurig Dr Pepper is a modern beverage company, with more than 125 brands people know and love. We challenge the usual and always push beyond the expected. We are building a culture that is our competitive advantage – one that is growth-focused, change-resilient, collaborative, innovative, nimble, diverse and inclusive.

Are you ready to do impactful work?  You’ll coach and mentor leaders. You’ll create and execute ambitious business and people strategies. You’ll play an important leadership role in our diversity & inclusion efforts. You’ll collaborate with other cross-functional leaders to implement and DELIVER BIG on KDP’s business objectives.

Are you ready to grow?  Here’s what will make you successful at KDP! We love passionate, courageous leaders who work with agility and are excited by new challenges. You’ll need to have a team-first mentality, strong customer centric and influencing skills, an entrepreneurial spirit, business insight and analytical capability, and a heart for supporting the needs of our team members.

Will you be the next member of our talented team?  If you’re ready, here’s more about the job!

As an Operations Manager , you will be responsible for the overall direction, guidance, and safety of multiple locations. You will put the health and safety of our team members first while assisting KDP in reaching our productivity and efficiency goals. You will lead and execute continuous improvement initiatives across cross-functional teams and projects, report on progress, make recommendations and support implementation. You will help foster our ONE KDP culture and environment by providing leadership, communication and performance management for your onsite people managers and team members, to enable the growth and development of our people and organization.

Your Responsibilities will include:
- Lead and manage diverse working teams including talent selection, leadership development, career coaching, and supervision of multiple departments/buildings.
- Develop team to solve day-to-day operational issues to reach short- and long-term performance goals while fostering a working environment of urgency, integrity and trust.
- Administer company policies, practices, and adherence to standard operating procedures, which includes enforcing and maintaining safety, food safety and environmental policies and procedures.
- Effectively utilize data to manage through various situations and display high emotional maturity when analyzing people impacts.
- Engage and collaborate with internal partners and functions to meet customer demands and provide high quality customer service.
- Regularly flex between hands on tactical and strategic work as necessary.
- Effectively manage difficult situations and assess the best solutions when impacting people, customers, and cost.
- Apply change management experience while also explaining change effectively to frontline associates

Total Rewards:
- $95,000 - $115,500 / year
- Actual placement within the compensation range may vary depending on experience, skills, and other factors
- Benefits, subject to election and eligibility: Medical, Dental and Vision, Paid Time Off, 401(k) program with employer match, Child & Elder Care, Adoption Benefits, Paid Parental Leave, Fertility Benefits, Employee Resource Groups, Breastmilk Shipping Services, Dependent Scholarship Program, Education Assistance, Employee Assistance Program, Personalized Wellness Platform and more!
- Annual bonus based on performance and eligibility

Requirements:
- High school diploma or general equivalency diploma (GED) with 5 years’ experience in a distribution center / DSD Warehouse environment OR a Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or related field with 3 years’ experience in a distribution center / DSD Warehouse environment

- Advanced skills using Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams)

Aperçu du poste:
** English version below / Version anglaise ci-dessous **

Stagiaire LEAP hiver 2027 – Excellence opérationnelle VHCS

Aperçu
Nous sommes à la recherche d’un ou d’une stagiaire en processus d’audit d’inventaire, rigoureux·euse et analytique, pour soutenir le développement et la mise en œuvre d’un programme formel d’audit d’inventaire au sein de l’équipe Excellence opérationnelle. Ce stage visera à renforcer les contrôles d’inventaire, améliorer l’exactitude des stocks, identifier les écarts de processus et créer des outils et de la documentation reproductibles afin de soutenir l’efficacité opérationnelle à long terme.
La personne sélectionnée contribuera à définir les procédures d’audit, à soutenir les audits pilotes, à analyser les écarts, à documenter les constats et à proposer des améliorations de processus visant à réduire les risques opérationnels et financiers.

Quart de travail / Horaire
- Dates du programme : 4 janvier au 30 avril 2027
- Lieu : Montréal, QC
- Mode hybride; 3 jours au bureau
- Du lundi au vendredi

Les éléments du programme de stage LEAP comprennent :
- Participer à des projets novateurs et collaborer avec différentes équipes afin d’acquérir de l’expérience dans un environnement dynamique et interfonctionnel.
- Bénéficier du soutien d’un mentor pour favoriser votre développement professionnel.
- Participer à des rencontres informelles et à des dîners-conférences avec des membres de la direction de KDP et d’autres leaders de l’organisation.
- Recevoir de la formation en développement professionnel, notamment sur le réseautage, les compétences professionnelles et les présentations.
- Réaliser un projet du début à la fin, puis le présenter, ainsi que vos apprentissages, à votre équipe, à votre service et à des leaders seniors afin de mettre en valeur votre travail et son impact sur l’entreprise.

Principales responsabilités
- Concevoir et soutenir un processus d’audit d’inventaire reproductible, incluant la méthodologie de comptage cyclique, les processus de rapprochement, les seuils et les normes de production de rapports.
- Définir les objectifs, la portée, la fréquence, les emplacements ainsi que les UGS ou familles de produits ciblées par les audits.
- Développer des outils pratiques, modèles, listes de vérification et documents de suivi pour soutenir l’exécution et la documentation des audits.
- Planifier et exécuter des audits pilotes dans certaines zones d’entrepôt ou catégories d’inventaire afin de valider le processus proposé.
- Rapprocher les décomptes physiques avec les données des systèmes et identifier les écarts liés aux erreurs de comptage, aux articles mal placés, aux erreurs de saisie, aux dommages ou aux lacunes de processus.
- Analyser les résultats d’audit afin de cerner les tendances, les causes fondamentales et les occasions d’amélioration.
- Créer une documentation claire sur les processus, des procédures opérationnelles normalisées, des guides de démarrage rapide et du matériel de formation.
- Soutenir les séances de formation pratique avec les équipes d’entrepôt et des opérations, et recueillir leurs commentaires afin de peaufiner le processus.
- Définir des indicateurs clés de performance pour suivre l’exactitude de l’inventaire, les taux d’écart, les délais de rapprochement et l’efficacité globale des audits.
- Recommander des fréquences de production de rapports, des formats de tableaux de bord et des initiatives d’amélioration continue afin de soutenir le contrôle de l’inventaire à long terme.

Exigences
- Être actuellement aux études dans un programme de baccalauréat en gestion de la chaîne d’approvisionnement, gestion des opérations, génie industriel, administration des affaires, logistique, systèmes d’information, analytique de données ou dans un domaine connexe.
- Excellente maîtrise d’Excel ou de Google Sheets, incluant les formules, les tableaux croisés dynamiques, RECHERCHEV/RECHERCHEX et la mise en forme conditionnelle.
- Compétences de base en analyse de données requises; la connaissance de SQL, Python, des systèmes ERP/WMS, de Power BI, Tableau ou Looker est considérée comme un atout.
- Grand souci du détail et engagement envers l’exactitude.
- Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes analytiques et capacité à investiguer les causes fondamentales.
- Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale.
- Aisance à travailler dans des environnements opérationnels ou d’entrepôt.
- Bonne gestion du temps et capacité à respecter les échéanciers liés aux projets ou aux audits pilotes.
- Esprit de collaboration et ouverture à recevoir de la rétroaction afin d’améliorer les processus.
- Fiabilité, ponctualité et capacité à respecter les procédures de santé et sécurité en entrepôt.
- Expérience avec les décomptes physiques, les audits, les procédures opérationnelles normalisées, les listes de vérification ou la documentation de processus, un atout important.
- Capacité à être sur place pour les décomptes d’inventaire, les séances de formation et certaines activités physiques occasionnelles, comme marcher, rester debout ou soulever de petites boîtes.

Exigences linguistiques
La maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral et à l’écrit, est requise. Toute autre compétence linguistique pertinente aux environnements d’entrepôt, d’opérations ou de fournisseurs est considérée comme un atout.

Winter 2027 LEAP Intern – VHCS Operational Excellence

Overview:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Inventory Audit Process Intern to support the development and implementation of a formal inventory audit program within the Operational Excellence team. This internship will focus on strengthening inventory controls, improving stock accuracy, identifying process gaps, and creating repeatable tools and documentation that support long-term operational efficiency.
The selected intern will help define audit procedures, support pilot audits, analyze discrepancies, document findings, and contribute to process improvements that reduce operational and financial risk.

Shift / Schedule
- Program Dates: January 4 – April 30, 2027
- Location: Montréal, QC
- Hybrid; 3 days in office
- Monday–Friday

Elements of the LEAP Internship Program include:
- Engaging and partnering on innovative projects to gain experience in a fast paced, cross functional team environment
- Receive mentor support for your professional development
- Participate in meet & greets and lunch & learns with KDP executives and other organization leaders
- Receive professional development training such as networking, professional skills development and presenting
- Complete a project from start to finish and present it and your takeaways to your team, department, and senior leaders to highlight your project work and impact on the business

Key Responsibilities
- Design and support a repeatable inventory audit process, including cycle count methodology, reconciliation workflows, thresholds, and reporting standards.
- Define audit objectives, scope, frequency, locations, and targeted SKUs or product families.
- Develop practical tools, templates, checklists, and tracking documents to support audit execution and documentation.
- Plan and execute pilot audits in selected warehouse zones or inventory categories to validate the proposed process.
- Reconcile physical counts against system records and identify discrepancies related to miscounts, misplacements, entry errors, damage, or process gaps.
- Analyze audit results to identify patterns, root causes, and opportunities for improvement.
- Create clear process documentation, standard operating procedures, quick-start guides, and training materials.
- Support hands-on training sessions with warehouse and operations teams and gather feedback to refine the process.
- Define key performance indicators to monitor inventory accuracy, discrepancy rates, reconciliation timing, and overall audit effectiveness.
- Recommend reporting cadences, dashboard layouts, and continuous improvement initiatives to support long-term inventory control.

Requirements
- Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Logistics, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related fields.
- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including formulas, pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and conditional formatting.
- Basic data analysis skills are required; familiarity with SQL, Python, ERP/WMS systems, Power BI, Tableau, or Looker is considered an asset.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
- Analytical problem-solving skills and ability to investigate root causes.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills.
- Comfort working in operational or warehouse environments.
- Strong time management skills and ability to meet pilot or project deadlines.
- Collaborative mindset with a willingness to receive feedback and iterate on processes.
- Reliable, punctual, and able to follow warehouse safety procedures.
- Experience with physical counts, audits, SOPs, checklists, or process documentation is a strong plus.
- Ability to be on-site for inventory counts, training sessions, and occasional physical activity such as walking, standing, or lifting small boxes.

Language Requirements:
Proficiency in English and French, both written and verbal, is required. Additional language skills relevant to warehouse, operations, or supplier environments are considered an asset.

This position is responsible for leading cross functional teams to execute Hot Beverage Initiative projects for our Keurig Dr Pepper beverages. Projects will be of higher complexity with multiple interdependencies. The individual will work with internal & external business partners to drive full alignment of the project scope and timeline to ensure successful service across stakeholders. The project manager will engage as the primary point of contact for coordinating and ensuring timeline deliverables and strategic objectives are met.  As a member of the Supply Chain Initiatives Team, this position will share responsibility for developing, maintaining and improving formal project management methods and tools across the company.

What you will do:

Requirements may include, but are not limited to: item set up, artwork, sourcing location, capacity planning, production planning, demand planning, transportation, and master data management.

- Use project management tools to track progress and performance. Generate regular status reports and present findings to senior management.

jobs.description:
Job Overview:
The Compensation Manager will play a key role supporting the company's executive compensation programs while also partnering on enterprise-wide compensation initiatives. This role serves as a strategic partner to HR Business Partners, providing expert guidance on pay decisions, market competitiveness, and program design. In addition to core compensation responsibilities, this role will lead and support key projects and contribute to executive compensation, annual bonus, and long-term incentive (LTIP) processes, ensuring programs are competitive, compliant, and aligned with shareholder and company objectives.

Key Responsibilities
- Executive Compensation & Governance Support - Contribute to the design, administration, and analysis of executive compensation programs, including executive base salary, annual incentive (STIP), and long-term incentive (LTIP) plans.
- Prepare analyses and presentation materials for Compensation Committee meetings and executive compensation decisions in partnership with senior team members.
- Partner with Legal, Finance, and external compensation consultants to support executive compensation governance and compliance.
- Contribute to annual proxy statement (CD&A) preparation and executive compensation disclosures.
- Support executive market benchmarking, peer group analyses, and executive pay competitiveness reviews to inform compensation decisions.
- Coordinate equity grant administration, vesting events, and long-term incentive plan (LTIP) processes.
- Perform analyses related to executive employment agreements, severance arrangements, and executive compensation modeling.

- Compensation Program Design & Administration - Conduct market pricing, benchmarking, and internal equity analysis to ensure competitive and equitable pay practices.
- Develop financial models and cost analyses to evaluate compensation program effectiveness and support decision-making.
- Partner with HRBPs and business leaders to provide consultative guidance on offers, promotions, retention actions, and organizational changes.
- Monitor market trends and emerging practices to continuously evolve compensation programs.

- Annual Compensation Processes (Merit, Bonus, LTIP) - Support execution of annual compensation cycles, including merit, bonus, and long-term incentives.
- Develop tools, guidance, and communications to support HR and leader decision-making during compensation cycles.
- Ensure data integrity, audit readiness, and alignment across systems (e.g., Workday, comp planning tools).
- Conduct post-cycle analysis to assess outcomes and identify areas for improvement.

- Special Projects & Strategic Initiatives - Lead or support special compensation projects, including program redesign, harmonization efforts, and transformation initiatives.
- Contribute to enterprise-wide initiatives such as M&A integration, job architecture, or global program alignment.
- Drive continuous improvement in compensation processes, tools, and governance practices.
- Partner across HR COEs (Total Rewards, Talent, HRT) on cross-functional initiatives.

- Stakeholder Partnership & Communication - Act as a trusted advisor to HR Business Partners, translating complex compensation concepts into clear, actionable insights.
- Develop and deliver education and communication materials on compensation philosophy, programs, and policies.

- Advanced degree or Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) designation preferred

Experience
- 6+ years of experience in compensation, total rewards, finance, or related field

- Prior experience in executive compensation programs, bonus (STIP), and/or equity/LTIP administration
- Experience supporting annual compensation cycles (merit, bonus, equity)
- Experience leading compensation program development and implementation projects
- Experience enhancing and implementing compensation systems and reporting tools

- Strong understanding of compensation fundamentals, including market pricing, benchmarking, and pay equity

- Familiarity with financial modeling and cost impact analysis
- Understanding of regulatory and compliance considerations related to compensation programs (preferred)

Skills
- Strong quantitative and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights
- Ability to influence and advise leaders with credibility and confidence
- Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver complex projects in a fast-paced environment
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics
- Ability to work cross-functionally and build strong relationships across stakeholders

Successful candidates will also demonstrate these additional qualifications:
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, and a solutions-oriented mindset
- Strong initiative, self-managed, and ability to prioritize and multi-task

The Regional Sales Manager – Foodservice Solutions , North Carolina, serves as KDP’s front-line commercial lead for regional on-premise customers across the assigned territory. The RSM contributes to KDP’s volume, profit, and share growth by developing, selling, and executing customer plans across the KDP portfolio. Reporting to the Director of Regional Accounts East, this role requires a highly driven, organized, results-oriented sales leader with strong customer relationship skills and at least five years of consumer goods sales experience. Ideal candidates will have a proven record of sales success, the ability to manage multiple priorities in a demanding environment, experience calling on owner/operators and C-suite decision makers, and the financial acumen to negotiate multi-year agreements that create mutually beneficial outcomes for KDP and its customers.

jobs.title: Summer 2027 Intern - Associate Brand Manager - MBA
jobs.description:
Job Overview:
Summer 2027 MBA Marketing Intern
Associate Brand Manager Internship · Frisco, TX
10-Week Summer Program · June 7 – August 13, 2027
Full-Time / Hybrid

Build a career with flavor at Keurig Dr Pepper! Our MBA Marketing Internship gives first-year business school students the chance to tackle real brand challenges, develop best-in-class marketing skills, and leave a lasting mark on one of our iconic brands. Each intern is assigned an individual stretch project addressing a live business challenge — from brand strategy and consumer insights to data analysis and go-to-market planning — with final recommendations presented to our senior marketing leaders .

Every intern really does have the opportunity to impact our brands.  In fact, we may even implement the recommendations you bring forward.

ABOUT THE PROGRAM
IMPACT OUR BRANDS
Work on our portfolio of iconic brands during a dynamic 10-week program, taking real ownership of a live brand challenge from day one.

COLLABORATION, NOT COMPETITION
Deliver real results working alongside intern peers on individual real-time brand business challenges. We want everyone to succeed.

UNPARALLELED LEADERSHIP EXPOSURE
Regular networking opportunities with the highest levels of marketing leadership across our business.

WE PROVIDE THE COACHING, TRAINING & CULTURE TO SUCCEED
Our comprehensive internship experience is built on four pillars of support:

COACHING & FEEDBACK
- Consistent mentorship and feedback throughout the program
- Coaching & support from former interns
- Mid-point & final performance evaluations

HOLISTIC MARKETING TRAINING
- Marketing fundamentals
- Analytics & financials
- Consumer insights
- Operations & route-to-market
- Leadership & influencing skills

CULTURE & NETWORKING EVENTS
- Formal networking events with Marketing leaders
- ABM roundtable & feedback discussions
- Leadership coffee chats & happy hours

ACCESS TO LEADERSHIP
- Executive meet & greets
- Formal & informal leadership exposure
- Opportunities to build personal connections across the organization

WHAT YOU'LL DO
As a Summer MBA Marketing Intern, you will be assigned a project focused on a real business challenge . Projects are designed to stretch your analytical and strategic thinking . Throughout the summer you will develop and strengthen key managerial competencies with support from a dedicated Project Lead and Mentor .

BRAND ANALYTICS & INSIGHT GENERATION
Dive into brand, industry, and consumer data to identify business issues and opportunities. Apply multiple data sources — including syndicated tools such as Circana/IRI, Numerator, and YouGov — to uncover actionable insights and develop evidence-backed strategic recommendations.

BRAND PROJECT OWNERSHIP
Own and drive your individual summer brand project end-to-end, from initial scoping through final presentation to senior leaders. Work collaboratively with your Project Lead and cross-functional partners to shape your approach, build your story, and develop a fully formed strategic recommendation. Projects span areas such as brand strategy, innovation, digital shelf, consumer insights, and go-to-market planning.

CONSUMER UNDERSTANDING
Develop your understanding of the consumer — who they are, what they need, and how our brands can serve them better. Translate consumer insights into clear, actionable implications that inform your brand project recommendations. Begin building a working knowledge of brand equity fundamentals and what sets our brands apart in the marketplace.

BRAND STRATEGY SUPPORT
Contribute to brand planning conversations and assist in developing materials that bring your recommendations to life — including analyses, presentations, and strategic frameworks. Gain exposure to annual brand planning, budgeting processes, and cross-functional brand alignment under the guidance of your Project Lead.

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION
Engage with colleagues across Marketing, Consumer Insights, Finance, Innovation, Sales, and Operations to gather input and build a well-rounded business perspective. We challenge each intern to schedule at least five coffee chats with marketers outside of their day-to-day team over the course of the summer.

FINAL PRESENTATION
Deliver a 25–30-minute strategic presentation to senior Marketing leadership covering your key insights, strategic approaches, recommendations, and implementation considerations. Q&A follows. This is your moment to showcase your thinking and the impact of your work.

PROGRAM LOGISTICS
- Program dates: June 7 – August 13, 2027
- Full-time,  40 hours  per week, Monday – Friday
- Hybrid work model based out of Frisco, Texas ( Beverage Company Operating Unit HQ)

ONBOARDING & ONGOING SUPPORT
We onboard interns as if they were full-time new hires and pair every intern with a dedicated support team:
- Marketing Capabilities Team — leads overall program onboarding, training, and intern success
- Project Lead — Brand Manager+ who coaches daily, provides real-time feedback, and guides the brand project
- Mentor — Supports cultural integration, soft-skill development, and performance review preparation
- Data Buddy — A dedicated resource for navigating Circana /IRI and other data platforms
- Former Intern — Provides peer guidance and support drawn from their own internship experience

Total Rewards:
- $2,250 per week
- Paid bi-weekly
- $7,000 Sign-on Bonus, paid within 30 days of employment

Requirements:
- Currently enrolled in a two-year, full-time MBA program; must be between your 1st and 2nd year (expected graduation the year following the internship)
- 3–6 years of full-time, post-undergraduate professional experience
- Strong analytical aptitude — able to work with data and translate findings into stories and strategic action
- Proficiency  in Excel and PowerPoint
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment
- Marketing concentration is not  required  but is a plus
- CPG, beverage, or brand marketing experience is a plus
- Experience with syndicated marketing research databases (e.g.,  Circana /IRI, Numerator, YouGov, Mintel) is a plu s

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
Our ideal intern brings a general manager and challenger mindset with a passion for our brands and our consumers. We evaluate interns across two dimensions:

The "What" — Results
- Analytical rigor — synthesizes data and develops insight-driven, strategic recommendations
- Framing & storytelling — frames recommendations into a persuasive, clear narrativ e
- Consumer & shopper-driven insights —  demonstrates  genuine passion for understanding the consumer
- Strategic thought leadership — thinks critically, combines qualitative and quantitative inputs, and applies brand stewardship principle s
- Balanced priorities —  demonstrates  growing business acumen and proactively takes ownership

The "How" — Behaviors
- Cross-functional collaboration — actively engages beyond their immediate team
- Agility & navigating ambiguity — intellectually curious, quick-thinking, no ego
- Self-awareness & professional maturity — understands their impact and engages appropriately at all levels
- Receptive to coaching — takes feedback constructively and uses it to improve in real time
- Influence & drive for impact — results-oriented, evidence-based, with an enterprise mindset
- Relationship building — builds authentic connections across the organization

Please note: You must be work authorized in the United States on a full time basis without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future. The Company cannot offer employment to F-1 (student) visa holders who require employer sponsorship in the future or cannot work now on a full time basis.

Job Overview:
Thirsty for your next challenge? Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP) is looking for a proven, analytically minded leader to join its Target Category Management team as a Manager and lead our Category Captain partnership with Target.

As Category Captain, KDP is Target’s trusted, objective advisor for the total beverage category — and this role steers that partnership. You’ll be a business and process owner for the long-term category vision that aligns KDP and Target goals. You’ll turn high-quality analysis into shelf-winning, shopper-first strategy and elevate engagement with Target merchant leadership. Deep knowledge of Target’s operating environment plus standout communication and influence skills are a must.

This position is located at our downtown Minneapolis, MN office. Hybrid schedule: 3 days in office, 2 days from home each week.

What you will do:

- Build relationships with Target merchant and leadership contacts, cementing KDP as their indispensable Category Captain and strategic partner
- Own the long-term category strategy, setting the vision and priorities that align KDP and Target growth goals

- Direct robust analysis — research, category tools, and data visualization — to surface and communicate business opportunities and challenges
- Lead cross-functional and Target merchant collaboration to deliver growth, build strategic and tactical solutions, and ensure POG accuracy and compliance
- Own inline planogram transitions and revisions with the Target merchant team

- 2+ years CPG category management experience, including a track record of leading large, complex retail accounts

- Skill at turning facts and insights into compelling stories with actionable recommendations

jobs.description:
Job Overview:
At Keurig Dr Pepper, our mission is to provide a beverage for every need, everywhere people shop and consume.  With a portfolio of more than 125 iconic brands that consumers know and love, we are one of the largest food and beverage companies in the US.  We keep the consumer at the heart of everything that we do, and that is why KDP holds strong leadership positions in most beverage categories.

We are looking for a Brand Manager to lead our marketing efforts on iconic brands such as Dr Pepper®, Canada Dry®, Snapple®, Bai®, Mott's®, CORE Hydration®, among others.  You will have the opportunity to work on brands that are loved by millions of consumers, and your strategic thought leadership and ability to work with diverse teams to develop and execute marketing plans will help these brands expand their leadership positions.

What You’ll Do:

At KDP, our Brand Managers are leaders who have challenger mindsets.  They put the consumer at the heart of everything they do, and they lead with a General Management mindset.  In this role, you will:

- Drive the development of your brand’s strategy, establishing its vision and growth objectives by leveraging consumer insights, category and consumer trends, and your deep understanding of our competition and the needs of our customers

- Lead from the front and strategically allocate resources – both dollars and people – to achieve goals

- Lead and partner with communications, insights, and commercial teams to identify growth opportunities, build plans and execute world class marketing programs

- Own your brand’s integrated communications strategy from briefing to optimization to measurement. You will tap into expertise from A-list agencies and media partners to deliver communications plans that penetrate culture.

- Be the face of your brand, championing your growth initiatives rooted in consumer needs and keen business expertise

Total Rewards:
- Salary Range: $96,800-150,000
- Actual placement within the compensation range may vary depending on experience, skills, and other factors

Requirements
We are looking for leaders who have the drive and desire to make a big impact, who are motivated by results, who thrive at working with diverse teams to tackle big challenges, and who have a true passion for marketing.

- Bachelor’s Degree required; MBA is preferred

- At least 3 years of brand marketing or brand management experience. CPG/Beverage experience from a Fortune 500 CPG company preferred.

- A general manager mindset where you exhibit data influenced decision making and measurement

- Exceptional team leader with a commanding presence and an ability to influence across functions, leadership levels and customer teams

- Proven ability to operate in a fast-paced environment, reacting with urgency, agility, sound judgement and often without specific direction

- Proven ability to manage through and lead change

jobs.title: Analyste Principale, Gestion de la croissance des revenus (RGM) des marques/ Associate Manager, Brand Revenue Growth Management (RGM)
jobs.location: Montreal, Quebec, Canada; Toronto, Ontario, Canada
jobs.description:
Aperçu du poste:
Le ou la Analyste Principale, Gestion de la croissance des revenus des marques est responsable de la croissance rentable d’un portefeuille de marques grâce à l’analyse des catégories, à la stratégie commerciale, à la tarification, à l’efficacité des promotions et à la planification interfonctionnelle. Ce poste implique une collaboration étroite avec les équipes du marketing, des ventes, des finances et de la chaîne d’approvisionnement afin de fournir des analyses, des recommandations et un leadership commercial qui soutiennent les objectifs de croissance et améliorent les performances sur le marché.

Principales responsabilités
- Catégories et performances commerciales - Diriger l’élaboration des analyses mensuelles par catégorie pour les marques directes de l’entrepôt, notamment Clamato, Nestea, Fruitsations, Atypique et d’autres marques prioritaires.
- Analyser les performances des marques et des catégories, notamment les tendances en matière de parts de marché, l’activité de la concurrence, la tarification et l’efficacité des promotions.
- Fournir des perspectives traduisibles en actions et des recommandations pour soutenir la prise de décision commerciale et identifier les opportunités de croissance.
- Élaborer et tenir à jour les présentations et les rapports de performance destinés aux équipes interfonctionnelles et à la direction.

- Gestion de la croissance des revenus et stratégie commerciale - Diriger les initiatives de gestion de la croissance des revenus pour Snapple, Realemon, Stewart’s, Rose’s et d’autres marques attribuées :
- Élaborer et tenir à jour des manuels stratégiques annuels, en s’assurant qu’ils s’alignent sur les objectifs de croissance des marques et les stratégies clients.
- Mettre en place et gérer les principes fondamentaux de vente des marques, notamment les directives en matière de tarification, de promotion, d’assortiment et de distribution.
- Identifier et exploiter les opportunités de croissance du chiffre d’affaires grâce à la tarification, à l’optimisation des promotions, à la gestion du portefeuille et à l’élaboration de stratégies commerciales.
- Fournir des conseils stratégiques aux partenaires interfonctionnels afin de soutenir une croissance rentable et la performance de l’entreprise.

- Innovation, planification et gestion de portefeuille - Pour les marques qui vous sont attribuées :
- Assurer le soutien de la gestion de la croissance des revenus dans le cadre des initiatives d’innovation de nouveaux produits, notamment les prévisions, l’élaboration d’analyses de rentabilité et la planification de la commercialisation.
- Gérer les hypothèses de prévision et soutenir les activités de gestion des stocks et de l’obsolescence.
- Diriger l’élaboration du plan commercial annuel et du plan de fonctionnement annuel.
- Suivre les performances par rapport aux prévisions et identifier les risques, les opportunités et les mesures correctives.

- Leadership interfonctionnel - Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes du marketing, des ventes, des finances et de la chaîne d’approvisionnement afin d’assurer la cohérence des initiatives stratégiques.
- Diriger et participer à des réunions interfonctionnelles afin de soutenir la planification, les prévisions, l’innovation et la gestion de la performance de l’entreprise.
- Influencer la prise de décision grâce à de solides capacités d’analyse et à un sens des affaires.

Qualifications
- Baccalauréat en commerce, marketing, finance, économie ou dans un domaine connexe.
- 3 à 5 ans d’expérience dans la gestion de la croissance des revenus, la gestion des catégories, la stratégie de vente, la planification commerciale, les finances ou des domaines connexes.
- Expérience dans le domaine des biens de consommation emballés (CPG) souhaitée.
- Solides compétences en matière d’analyse, de finance et de résolution de problèmes.
- Maîtrise avancée d’Excel et de PowerPoint.
- Excellentes compétences en matière de communication, de présentation et de gestion des parties prenantes.
- Capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités et à travailler efficacement dans un environnement au rythme rapide.

Rémunération globale:
- CAD $78,300 - $102,300 annuel.
- Le classement dans la fourchette de rémunération peut varier en fonction de l'expérience, des compétences et d'autres facteurs.
- Boni annuel basé sur le rendement et l’admissibilité. Avantages sociaux, sous réserve de l'admissibilité : assurance médicale, dentaire, invalidité, assurance-vie, congés payés (y compris les vacances et les congés personnels), REER avec contribution de l'entreprise, remboursement des frais de scolarité, programme d'aide aux employés et à la famille.

_________________________________________________________
- Salary Range: CAD $78,300 - $102,300
- Actual placement within the compensation range may vary depending on experience, skills, and other factors.
- Annual bonus based on performance and eligibility. Benefits, subject to eligibility: medical, dental, disability, life insurance, paid time off (including vacation and personal time), RRSP with company match, tuition reimbursement, employee and family assistance program.

Exigences:
The Associate Manager, Brand Revenue Growth Management (RGM) is responsible for driving profitable growth across a portfolio of brands through category analytics, commercial strategy, pricing, promotional effectiveness, and cross-functional planning. This role partners closely with Marketing, Sales, Finance, and Supply Chain teams to provide insights, recommendations, and business leadership that support growth objectives and improve marketplace performance.

Key Responsibilities
- Category & Business Performance - Lead the development of monthly category reviews for Warehouse Direct brands including Clamato, Nestea, Fruitsations, Atypique, and other priority brands.
- Analyze brand and category performance, including market share trends, competitive activity, pricing, and promotional effectiveness.

jobs.title: Summer 2027 Intern - Associate Brand Manager - MBA (Emeryville, CA)
jobs.description:
Job Overview:
Summer 2027 MBA Marketing Intern ship
Associate Brand Manager · Emeryville, CA
10-Week Summer Program · June 7 – August 13, 2027
Full-Time / Hybrid

Build a career with flavor at Keurig Dr Pepper! Our MBA Marketing Internship gives first-year business school students the chance to tackle real brand challenges, develop best-in-class marketing skills, and leave a lasting mark on one of our iconic brands. Each intern is assigned an individual stretch project , spanning from brand strategy and consumer insights to data analysis and go-to-market planning , with final recommendations presented to our senior marketing leaders.

ABOUT THE PROGRAM
Our comprehensive internship experience is built on four pillars of support:
COACHING & FEEDBACK
- Consistent mentorship and feedback throughout the program

- Coaching & support from former interns

- Mid-point & final performance evaluations

HOLISTIC MARKETING TRAINING
- Marketing fundamentals

- Analytics & financials

- Consumer insights

- Operations & route-to-market

- Leadership & influencing skills

CULTURE & NETWORKING EVENTS
- Formal networking events with Marketing leaders

- ABM roundtable & feedback discussions

- Leadership coffee chats & happy hours

ACCESS TO LEADERSHIP
- Executive meet & greets

- Formal & informal leadership exposure

- Opportunities to build personal connections across the organization

WHAT YOU'LL DO
As an intern, you will be assigned a project designed to stretch your analytical and strategic thinking . Throughout the summer you will develop and strengthen key managerial competencies with support from a dedicated Project Lead and Mentor .

TRANSFORM DATA TO INSIGHTS
Dive into brand, industry, and consumer data to  identify  business issues and opportunities. L earn how to use multiple data sources ( i ncluding tools such as  IRI, Numerator , and YouGov) t o uncover actionable insights and develop evidence-backed strategic recommendations ; and t hrive with support from your Data Buddy , a dedicated resource for you throughout the program .

GENERATE FUEL FOR GROWTH
Own and drive your individual summer brand project end-to-end, from  initial  scoping through final presentation to senior leaders. Work collaboratively with your Project Lead and cross-functional partners to shape your approach, build your story, and develop a fully formed strategic recommendation. Projects span areas such as brand strategy, innovation, digital shelf, consumer insights, and go-to-market planning.

CHAMPION CONSUMER OBSESSED BRAND BUILDING
Develop your understanding of the consumer : who they are, what they need, and how our brands can serve them better. Translate consumer insights into clear, actionable implications that inform your brand project recommendations. Begin building a working knowledge of brand equity fundamentals and what sets our brands apart in the marketplace.

SHAPE BRAND STRATEGY
Contribute to brand planning conversations and  assist  in developing materials that bring your recommendations to life. Gain exposure to annual brand planning, budgeting processes, st rategic frameworks and cross-functional brand alignment under the guidance of your Project Lead.

AMPLIFY IMPACT WITH CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION
Engage with colleagues across Marketing, Consumer Insights, Finance, Innovation, Sales, and Operations to gather input and build a well-rounded business perspective. We challenge each intern to schedule at least five coffee chats with marketers outside of their day-to-day team over the course of the summer.

PRESENT TO MARKETING LEADERSHIP
Deliver a 25–30-minute strategic presentation to senior Marketing leadership covering your key insights, strategic approaches, recommendations, and implementation considerations. Q&A follows. This is your moment to  showcase  your thinking and the impact of your work.

Total Rewards:
- $2,250/week

- Paid bi-weekly

- $7,000 sign-on bonus, paid within first 30 days of employment

Requirements:
- Currently enrolled in a two-year, full-time MBA program; must be between your 1st and 2nd year (expected graduation the year following the internship)

- 3–6 years of full-time, post-undergraduate professional experience

- Strong analytical aptitude — able to work with data and translate findings into stories and strategic action

- Proficiency  in Excel and PowerPoint

- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment

- Marketing concentration is not  required  but is a plus

- CPG, beverage, or brand marketing experience is a plus

- Experience with syndicated marketing research databases (e.g.,  Circana /IRI, Numerator, YouGov, Mintel) is a plu s

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
Our ideal intern brings a general manager and challenger mindset with a passion for our brands and our consumers. We evaluate interns across two dimensions:

The "What" — Results
- Analytical rigor — synthesizes data and develops insight-driven, strategic recommendations

- Framing & storytelling — frames recommendations into a persuasive, clear narrativ e

- Consumer & shopper-driven insights —  demonstrates  genuine passion for understanding the consumer

- Strategic thought leadership — thinks critically, combines qualitative and quantitative inputs, and applies brand stewardship principle s

- Balanced priorities —  demonstrates  growing business acumen and proactively takes ownership

The "How" — Behaviors
- Cross-functional collaboration — actively engages beyond their immediate team

- Agility & navigating ambiguity — intellectually curious, quick-thinking, no ego

- Self-awareness & professional maturity — understands their impact and engages appropriately at all levels

- Receptive to coaching — takes feedback constructively and uses it to improve in real time

- Influence & drive for impact — results-oriented, evidence-based, with an enterprise mindset

- Relationship building — builds authentic connections across the organization

This role is specific to the Coffee Operating Unit of KDP. Following the successful acquisition of JDE Peet's in April 2026, the Coffee Operating Unit will become its own independent publicly traded company. For more information, please visit keurigdrpepper.com.

Please note : You must be work-authorized in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.  The Company cannot offer employment to F-1 visa holders who require sponsorship.

jobs.description:
Job Overview:
Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP) operates a broad and highly visible Marketing and Business Services portfolio that enables brand growth, commercial execution, workforce effectiveness, and enterprise operations across North America. This highly dynamic environment with rapid shifts creates opportunities for Procurement to improve value, agility, innovation, and risk management.

The Sr. Manager of Procurement & Category Management – Marketing & Business Services owns sourcing and category strategy across assigned Marketing and Business Services categories. The portfolio includes marketing agencies and production, content and activation services, human resources services, consulting and professional services, travel, facilities and real estate services, and other corporate services as assigned.

This leader is accountable for value delivery while protecting quality, speed, service, compliance, and business continuity. The role shapes multi-year category strategies, leads complex sourcing and negotiations, strengthens governance, and applies analytics and intelligence to improve how KDP buys and manages services. The role partners closely with Global Marketing and Business Service Procurement, Marketing, Brand, Sales, Human Resources, Finance, Legal, Real Estate, Facilities, Sustainability, and other Corporate Functions to translate business priorities into practical sourcing strategies and supplier solutions.

Reporting to North America Procurement leadership, this position leads procurement and category management professionals supporting the North America business. Some travel is required for business reviews, stakeholder meetings, site visits, and negotiations.

The position is based in the Burlington, MA, Montreal, Canada, or Essex, VT office and will have a hybrid schedule.

Category scope: Creative and advertising agencies, content and production, shopper and experiential marketing, digital and social content, sponsorship and promotional services, market research, print and marketing materials, human resources services, consulting and professional services, contingent labor, travel, meetings and events, facilities and real estate services, integrated facilities management, and other corporate services as assigned.
Essential Responsibilities
- Own category strategy for Marketing and Business Services spend. Build multi-year roadmaps balancing cost, impact, quality, innovation, agility, service, and risk.
- Partner with senior Global Marketing and Business Services Procurement, Marketing, Brand, Sales, Human Resources, Finance, Legal, Real Estate, Facilities, and others to align strategies to AOP and long-term priorities.
- Develop deep understanding of category spend, specifications, demand drivers, supplier landscapes, agency and service-provider economics, market dynamics, and emerging category trends.
- Lead annual and in-year sourcing initiatives, including RFI, RFP, supplier selection, negotiation, contracting, implementation, and benefits realization across assigned categories.
- Design fit-for-purpose commercial models, scopes of work, rate cards, fee structures, performance incentives, indexation, and consumption controls that improve transparency and value.
- Identify and deliver sustainable productivity, cash, demand management, supplier consolidation, specification optimization, process efficiency, and cost-avoidance opportunities.
- Balance value with impact, quality, speed, stakeholder experience, continuity, and service performance.
- Bring external intelligence and benchmark to models, content production, AI-enabled marketing, professional services, labor markets, travel, real estate, facilities, and other services into category strategy and negotiations.
- Establish strategic supplier governance through segmentation, scorecards, business reviews, continuous improvement plans, innovation agendas, corrective actions, and escalation protocols.
- Develop executive relationships with strategic agencies and service providers to drive innovation, service improvement, risk reduction, and long-term value creation.
- Strengthen contract coverage and compliance, including clear deliverables, service levels, intellectual property, data and privacy requirements, audit rights, business continuity, payment terms, and performance remedies in partnership with Legal and key stakeholders.
- Mitigate supplier and service risk through due diligence, financial and operational risk assessments, contingency planning, responsible sourcing, and continuity plans for critical services.
- Improve spend visibility, pipeline management, forecast accuracy, supplier data, and contract compliance through procurement systems, sourcing platforms, and analytics tools.
- Lead Marketing and Business Services procurement transformation initiatives that simplify ways of working, improve stakeholder adoption, and position Procurement as an early strategic partner.
- Leverage KDP and JDE Peet’s scale, supplier relationships, benchmarks, and cross-region synergies where they create value while tailoring solutions to North America business requirements.
- Build and develop a high-performing team, fostering capability growth, engagement, accountability, collaboration, and succession readiness.
- Champion collaboration across Procurement and business functions to ensure effective execution, measurable outcomes, and sustainable results.

Key Performance Indicators
- Delivery of annual productivity, cost avoidance, cash, and value creation against AOP.
- Category strategy coverage, sourcing pipeline health, forecast accuracy, and realization of approved initiatives.
- Supplier performance against agreed quality, service, delivery, innovation, risk, diversity, and sustainability metrics.
- Contract coverage, competitive sourcing penetration, spend visibility, and compliance across addressable spend.
- Marketing value indicators such as agency fee efficiency, rate-card performance, production efficiency, scope control, and speed-to-market.
- Business Services value indicators such as utilization, demand reduction, service-level performance, rate competitiveness, and total cost of ownership.
- Stakeholder satisfaction, early Procurement engagement, and business partner effectiveness.
- Supplier innovation, continuous improvement, risk mitigation, and issue-resolution effectiveness.
- Team engagement, capability development, retention, and succession readiness.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

jobs.title: Senior Procurement Manager -  Capex, MRO & MRO Services, and Utilities
jobs.location: Burlington, Massachusetts, United States; Essex Junction, Vermont, United States; Montreal, Quebec, Canada
jobs.description:
Job Overview:
Across KDP's multi-site North America manufacturing and distribution network, capital investment, plant reliability, MRO parts and services, and utilities are categories critical to supply chain performance.
The Senior Manager owns sourcing and category strategy for the capital and plant services portfolio: Capex, MRO supplies, spare parts, maintenance services, and utilities and telecom: This role is accountable for total value delivery while protecting uptime, parts availability, project timelines, and business continuity.
This role leads bid events, builds should-cost and TCO models, negotiates supply and service agreements, establishes supplier governance, and partners with Global Sourcing, Engineering, Maintenance and Reliability, Capital Projects, Operations, Facilities, Finance, and Legal to translate business and technical requirements into strategies that lower total cost while preserving reliability and continuity.
Reporting to North America Procurement leadership, this position leads a team of category managers and is based in the Burlington, MA; Montreal, Canada; or Essex, VT office on a hybrid schedule. Some travel is required for supplier reviews, site visits, and negotiations.

Category Scope

Capital equipment; MRO supplies, spare parts, and support equipment; MRO and maintenance services; storeroom and inventory programs; utilities (electricity, natural gas, water); and telecom. A total of $284M in addressable spend.

Essential Responsibilities
- Owns category strategy with Global Sourcing across Capex, MRO, MRO Services, and Utilities & Telecom, building multi-year roadmaps balancing total cost, reliability, service, and risk.
- Lead bid events and design award value maximizing strategies while protecting uptime, parts availability, schedules.
- Apply full Strategic Category Management toolkit (RFQ/RFP/RFI, online auctions, collaborative sourcing, multi-event negotiations.
- Build should-cost, TCO, and lifecycle-cost models; manage escalation mechanisms, indices, and inflation exposure across equipment, parts, services, and energy.
- Develop market intelligence to shape long-term strategy and prepare the category Annual Operating Plan and savings models in partnership with Finance.
- Embed procurement early in capital planning with Engineering and Capital Projects, driving standardization, competitive bidding, and value engineering.
- Partner with Maintenance and Reliability to optimize MRO parts strategies, storeroom and inventory management, vendor-managed inventory, integrated supply, and critical-spares availability.
- Source and manage MRO and maintenance services agreements, including scope, SLAs, rate structures, and safety and compliance requirements.
- Develop utilities and energy strategies — deregulated market procurement, contract structuring and optimize telecom sourcing and cost.
- Negotiate agreements with Legal and key stakeholders and administer contracts in line with policy.
- Identify value-optimization opportunities and lead productivity efforts that support overall goals.
- Proactively assess supplier risk and maintain business continuity plans: including dual-sourcing of critical parts and supplier financial-health monitoring and ensure suppliers meet all applicable food-safety regulations and KDP's Ethical Sourcing Policy.
- Partner cross-functionally to advance KDP's responsible sourcing agenda
- Build supplier KPIs and governance using scorecards, quarterly business reviews, continuous improvement, corrective action plans, and escalation protocols.
- Develop executive relationships with strategic suppliers that drive innovation, capacity assurance, and service improvement.
- Influence stakeholders on procurement policy and practice, strengthen data quality, spend visibility, and contract compliance across the supply base.
- Build and develop a high-performing team: setting expectations, evaluating, coaching, and growing capability, engagement, accountability, and succession readiness.
- Establish staffing and resource plans, determining the right mix of sourcing activity and managing third-party resource performance.

Key Performance Indicators
- Delivery of annual productivity, cost avoidance, and value creation against AOP.
- Total cost and TCO improvement across capital projects, MRO parts and services, and utilities.
- Capital sourcing effectiveness: competitive bid coverage, standardization, and value-engineering realization.
- MRO parts performance: fill rate, critical part coverage, and inventory turns.
- Utilities and energy cost performance versus market indices and contract-coverage position.
- Supplier service and quality performance, savings pipeline health, contract coverage and compliance.
- Stakeholder satisfaction, team engagement, talent development, and succession readiness.

- Demonstrated experience sourcing capital equipment and projects, MRO supplies and services, and/or utilities and energy.
- Proven record leading bid events and negotiating supply, services, and Capex agreements with measurable cost and service improvement.
- Expert in should-cost modeling, TCO and lifecycle costing, and price/index escalation mechanics.
